messages:
Anya (PM): Quick heads-up — starting a PRD thread for a 'release lanes' rollout model. We need lanes for stable/canary/experimental, tenant pinning API, ramp schedule, rollback heuristics, and manual override flows. Asking Eng/SRE/Data/CS/Legal to weigh in.
Sam (Eng): SG. quick question: is a lane tied to a model artifact (weights) only or to runtime config (quant, batch, kernel selection) as well?
Anya (PM): Lane = model variant + runtime config. We want to be able to fallback to a cheaper quantized variant when capacity tight, but keep a clear pin to ensure customers stay on the variant they expect.
Mike (SRE): Need explicit rollback triggers and guardrails. Proposal: error-rate delta > 2x baseline for 10m, p99 latency increase > 300ms for 15m, or new uncaught exceptions spike. Also require per-region kill-switch and an emergency 'global-off' flag.
Jess (Data): For experiments we need primary/secondary metrics. Suggest primary = production-quality eval on seed prompts + p99 latency. Secondary = user-facing proxy metrics (completion length, finetune-ctr) and cost/tokens per request.
Anya (PM): Copying proposed ACs here:
```
ACs:
- tenant pin via API + console, with optional expiry TTL
- release lanes: stable/canary/experimental mapping to (model, config)
- canary ramp schedule: 1% -> 10% (manual approve) -> 50% over 24h by default
- rollback triggers:
  - request_error_rate_delta > 2x baseline over 10m
  - p99_latency increase > 300ms sustained 15m
  - quality_regression on eval set > 5% absolute drop
- telemetry events emitted: lane_assigned, ramp_step, rollback_triggered, pin_created
- role-based runbook with manual rollback and communication steps
```
Sam (Eng): Implementation notes: we'll need a new 'lane' column on tenant routing table, support for TTL expirations, and routing precedence. Also need to define fallback compatibility between variants.
Anya (PM): Sign-off criteria: Product + Eng + SRE + Data + CS OK on ACs; runbook stub exists; and a small canary test with internal tenants before commercial rollout.
Chris (Legal): Quick note — ensure pins can't bypass customer data residency controls. For Private/VPC customers, pins must not route to hosted-only variants. Add a compliance check to the routing policy.
Maya (CS): How will customers request a permanent pin? Support ticket, or self-serve from Console? We get asks for 'keep me on old model until we validate outputs'.
Anya (PM): Plan: support ticket for now (to verify intent), then Console flow in next quarter with warnings about cost and compatibility. We'll record pin owner and justification.
deploy-bot: Reminder: add telemetry hooks for rollout_started, ramp_checkpoint, rollback_evidence. Also include a sampling of request traces for 1% of canary traffic.
Jess (Data): I'll draft the experiment slate (primary/secondary metrics + analysis notebook) and share by EOD tomorrow.
Mike (SRE): I'll draft rollback runbook and emergency kill-switch implementation. Will need Eng to add the endpoint and auth checks.
Sam (Eng): I'll scope the DB changes and runtime routing work — aim for a lightweight RFC early next week.
Anya (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll create the PRD + RFC draft (link will be posted in this thread) and tag reviewers. Tag me if you want your paragraph added. :thumbsup:
